title: Pivot-and-Pass Square
description: Four players form a square; each catches, pivots to face the next corner and passes, so the ball travels round the square with constant pivoting.

content.objective: Catch on balance, pivot without travelling and pass to the next player, linking the three basic skills.
content.setup: Four players stand at the corners of a five-metre square.
content.organization: Groups of four; one ball, then two balls.
instructions: The player with the ball passes to the right-hand corner.
The receiver catches with a jump stop and chins the ball.
The receiver pivots to face the next corner and passes.
After two laps, reverse direction (pivot the other way).
Add a second ball at the opposite corner for more touches.
coachingPoints: Catch, pivot, pass: three distinct actions.
Pivot on the ball of the foot.
Show target hands before the ball comes.
content.safety: With two balls, call the receiver's name to avoid a player being hit while pivoting.
progressions: Two balls chasing each other round the square.
regressions: Bigger square, one ball, walking pace.
variations: Defender in the middle tries to intercept.
successCriteria: Two laps without a travel or a dropped pass.
Every catch ends in a balanced stop.
content.gameApplication: Pivoting to face the play after a catch is how players see the floor and pass without travelling.
